motor: 28BYJ-48 5V via ULN2003, half-step, 4096 half-steps per output turn

homing.note: drive down travel + overshoot; the gearbox stalls at the bottom stop; that is 0 mm
homing.stop_position_note: Where the stop post physically is, in the old-stop frame. 10 for a lid printed from the 2026-10-12 CAD (17.5 mm post: the mechanical bottom is wilted). 0 on the original lid, 25 with stop_spacer.stl or the 32.5 mm post; the bench lid's post was cut to 1.5.
homing.known_overshoot_note: margin past the expected stop when the position is known; the full overshoot_mm only applies to a blind home

working_max_note: 57.5 for the 165 mm drive rod (2026-10-12 CAD): above about 58.5 the straight rod wedges in the stem's natural curve near the head and the motor grinds.
bottom_stop_note: Mechanical bottom stop of the original lid, the frame all positions are measured in. Lids from the 2026-10-12 CAD carry a 17.5 mm post, so the stop sits at 10 (= wilted); see homing.stop_position_mm. Working range 10 to 57.5.
worst_air_note: 10 mm = fully wilted on the 2026-10-12 hardware (165 mm rod, 145 mm stem, 11 g head); 25 mm = horizontal.
positions_note: mm above the old bottom stop, from the bench on 2026-10-12 with a 165 mm drive rod (about 140 mm above the carriage boss), 145 mm stem from roof to head and 11 g added to the head: erect = 12 on the clock; leaning = 11; horizontal = 9 (the guideline line on the dashboard chart); wilted = past horizontal.

mapping.note: CO2 1000 ppm = classroom ventilation guideline (no WHO value exists for CO2); PM2.5 15 = WHO 24-h guideline, 25 = WHO interim target 4, 5 = WHO annual. Values between rows interpolate linearly. Edit and restart schoolair-flower.
mapping.valid_range_note: Outside these bounds a reading is a sensor fault (SEN6x sends CO2 32766 or PM 6553.5 for 'no valid value'): the flower holds and the LED shows thinking.
mapping.smoothing_note: Median of the readings from the last N seconds. 45 s = three 15-second readings (firmware normal cadence since endnode v2.3.20); one reading per window = no smoothing. 0 disables.

demo.note: used while /run/schoolair/demo exists (demonstrations: the firmware then reads every ~3 s); 9 s = median of three 3-second readings (10 would catch four)

moves.note: up in two-coil full steps at 2.5 ms: clean under the stem load on the 2026-10-12 hardware; down in half steps at 1.5 ms

recovery.note: after homing, climb out of the stop to 30 mm in full steps at 6 ms; the stem is folded hardest down there

moves.home_note: homing stroke (ends in a stall on the stop): half-steps at this rate, independent of down_us

unit: fill in: hostname of the endnode this calibration was measured on

heartbeat.note: a small dip-and-return so people can see the flower is alive; skipped when the last reading is stale, so a still flower means something has stopped

self_test.note: first start after power-up: home, rise to erect, then go to the reading. Without a reading: hold last known (or erect) and ask the LED for thinking; never park at wilted without a reading.

nightly_home.note: local time; re-home and return once a night so a lost position never lasts longer than a day
